name: Issue 2745: Surging Slash arms after the 3rd Runeblade cast
contract: Surging Slash 705579 reads 'Every 3rd cast of Runeblade now transforms your next Runeblade within $572358d
into Surging Slash.' Its only effect is a PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL of 572358, ProcChance 100, but Spell.dbc gives
705579 itself ProcFlags 0, so the aura never registered a proc and 572358 never applied on any Runeblade
cast. Runeblade (707141-707148, 573444-573447) is the only family 38 spell with mask2 0x40000 (DmgClass
melee); 572358 carries its own StackAmount 3 (DurationIndex 8, 15 sec), so once the proc fires on every
Runeblade cast the native aura system stacks it by 1 per cast, capped at 3 -- the 'every 3rd cast' counter
already lives in the DBC record. Expected: the 1st and 2nd Runeblade cast leave 572358 at 1 and 2 stacks;
the 3rd reaches 3. Consuming that stack to actually recast Runeblade as 803736 is a separate, unread
mechanic and out of scope for this issue.

steps.label: SETUP: the transform buff is absent
After the 1st cast the buff has 1 stack
After the 2nd cast the buff has 2 stacks
CONTRACT: the 3rd cast arms Surging Slash at 3 stacks
